screenshots.label: Meadow: a packed-earth road in a red brick curb through deep green grass, paved where it widens, three players building in their own shares
Desert: sandstone flags and a paved plaza across bright sand, red outcrops and teal pools, chain lightning and beams at the first bend
The volcano: a pale ash road between lava pools and copper-green crust, crimson ogres and gold imps marching into mortar and beam fire
A crystal vale: pale flagstones over violet ground, a column of ogres under violet bolt, rose beam and amber mortar towers
